text:
jess: Quick heads-up — I repro'd a noticeable perf regression on L40S with the fused-paged hybrid kernel. seq_len=512, batch=8. Walltime up ~20% vs last week. cc @omar @liam :eyes:
omar: Ugh, can you paste the numbers and which binary/kernel combo?
jess: Sure. Ran a small loop on the staging pool. perf-bot posted the microbench summary:
```
bench: fused-paged-hybrid
hw: L40S
seq: 512
batch: 8
throughput: 1.2k tokens/s (prev: 1.5k)
median latency: 220ms (prev: 180ms)
kernel: fused_paged_v2 -> fallback to paged_attn_kernel 30% of tokens
```
perf-bot: auto-profile://1901234567/flamegraph.html (upload) — hotspot: attention_kv_copy and tile_dispatch
liam: Was anything pushed to batching heuristics recently? The heuristic tweak in `commit: a1b2c3d` changed micro-batcher windowing.
omar: pinging that commit, could be causing different batch shaping and increased KV spills. jess, can you try with kv-cache disabled?
jess: Running now with `--kv-cache=off` and `--kernel=fused-only` to isolate. Command I used:
```bash
./tools/microbench --model=resnet-attn-sim --seq=512 --batch=8 --kernel=fused-paged-hybrid --runs=50
```
anya: Also try forcing tile_size=128, we saw pathological dispatch with 64 recently.
jess: Results with kv-cache off and fused-only: throughput 1.48k toks/s, latency 185ms — basically back to baseline. With kv-cache on, but forcing `tile_size=128`: 1.4k toks/s.
liam: That suggests the regression is in the interaction between kv cache codepath and the hybrid dispatcher. Possibly spill logic or k-v copy path.
omar: Can you grab a short perf trace (cuda profiler or perf-record) and a kernel launch list? Even a 30s run should show frequent falls back to paged kernel.
jess: Uploading short nsight snapshot: nsight://snapshots/1901234567/kv_spill_trace.nsys
perf-bot: Analysis: increased memcpy time on staging L40S nodes when fused_paged_v2 triggers fallback. Top counters: H2D memcpy spikes, kernel occupancy lower for paged kernel.
liam: I bet the batcher now allows slightly larger effective batches which push KV working set past the L2 tiling threshold, causing more memcopies. That matches the occupancy drop.
anya: Quick experiment idea: add a heuristic clamp to prefer fused-only when seq<=768 and batch<=8 on L40S. If that fixes we can roll a hotpatch.
omar: Agree. Recommend a quick gate: if (device==L40S && seq<=768 && batch<=8) prefer fused-only.
jess: I'll run the gated microbench across seq sweep (128,256,512,1024) and batch sweep (1,2,4,8) tonight. Posting results when done.
liam: Thanks — if you see a clear delta, we can ship a targeted heuristic revert/patch and add a test that catches this for future rollouts.
perf-bot: Created ticket RL-2389: "L40S fused-paged hybrid regression at mid-lengths" and linked this thread. :ticket:
jess: Filed the experimental run logs here: internal://benchlogs/1901234567/ — will update with the gated results. :thumbsup:
